verdict.rationale: GitHub ships an official open-source GitHub CLI (`gh`) for working with GitHub from the terminal, with quickstart commands like `gh repo clone`, and a probe confirmed its documentation at cli.github.com. For AI-native work it also ships an official Copilot CLI that runs Copilot directly from the terminal and installs via WinGet, Homebrew, npm or a script. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLIs in agentic workflows.
